description: This file contains Android UI tests for the ForYouScreen component in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It tests various UI states, interactions, and visibility of elements like loading indicators, topic chips, and the done button.

classes.name: ForYouScreenTest
classes.description: Test class containing various UI tests for the ForYouScreen component.

methods.name: circularProgressIndicator_whenScreenIsLoading_exists
methods.description: Tests that the loading indicator appears on screen when the ForYouScreen is in a loading state.

methods.name: circularProgressIndicator_whenScreenIsSyncing_exists
methods.description: Tests that the loading indicator appears when the screen is syncing.

methods.name: topicSelector_whenNoTopicsSelected_showsTopicChipsAndDisabledDoneButton
methods.description: Verifies that topic chips are shown and the 'Done' button is disabled when no topics are selected.

methods.name: topicSelector_whenSomeTopicsSelected_showsTopicChipsAndEnabledDoneButton
methods.description: Verifies that topic chips are shown and the 'Done' button is enabled when some topics are selected.

methods.name: feed_whenInterestsSelectedAndLoading_showsLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Checks that a loading indicator is visible when interests are selected and the feed is loading.

methods.name: feed_whenNoInterestsSelectionAndLoading_showsLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Checks that a loading indicator is visible when no interests are selected and the feed is loading.

methods.name: feed_whenNoInterestsSelectionAndLoaded_showsFeed
methods.description: Verifies that the feed shows news resources when loaded and no interests are selected.
